highlightAliases.old: Gabapentin requires dose reduction with a GFR below 60 in the table and is flagged for avoidance in end-stage renal disease; meperidine is flagged especially in chronic kidney disease because of its metabolite (p392).
highlightAliases.new: Gabapentin requires dose reduction with a GFR below 60 in the table and should be avoided in end-stage renal disease; meperidine is particularly problematic in chronic kidney disease because of its metabolite (p392).
